P1_research_volume_proxy.interpretation: NOT a content-penetration measure; reported for completeness. Research counts inversely relate to PDA per H2; cannot test H-Prev directly.

ahrefs_text_web_pages_pct.note: 74.2% of newly published web pages contain AI-generated text

kapwing_shorts_ai_slop_mid_pct.note: 21-33% of YouTube Shorts recommended to new users are AI slop; midpoint 27%

imperva_bot_traffic_pct.note: 51% of internet traffic is automated (bots); upper bound on AI-text saturation

graphite_articles_pct.note: 52% of analyzed English articles show AI involvement

decision: supported (>=50% of triangulated content-prevalence ratios meet 2x threshold)
limitations: Triangulated from cited industry sources, not a primary measurement.
Kapwing 'AI slop in Shorts recommended to new users' is an algorithm-amplified slice, not a population prevalence. True video AI-content prevalence may be higher in the long tail.
Ahrefs 'AI text on new web pages' includes any AI involvement, including light editing; raw fully-AI text prevalence may be lower.
Single-vendor estimates from Kapwing and Ahrefs have not been independently replicated.
